title: Turbo Tire
subtitle: A fast arcade destruction game where you drive a giant tire through a city, chaining boosts, ramps, and jumps to smash props and rack up score.
overview: Turbo Tire is an arcade-style score attack experience where the player controls a tire rolling through a city and causing as much destruction as possible. The core loop is built around momentum and spectacle: using boosters, ramps, and big jumps to crash into objects like billboards, poles, and other breakable props while maintaining speed and building points. The focus is on satisfying feedback, a strong sense of velocity, and readable visual effects during fast traversal.
role: I contributed primarily to the project’s visuals: creating untextured 3D models (props and environment pieces), building destruction VFX, and implementing speed-focused feedback. I set up a speed vignette, an outline shader to improve readability, god rays, and post-processing to push the overall look. I also created additional VFX elements to support impact feedback and reinforce the game’s fast, chaotic feel.
description: An arcade city-destruction prototype where you drive a tire, hit boosters and ramps, and smash props to score points.
